items.question: What is Relincho and who is it for?
items.answer: Relincho is comprehensive management software designed for stud farms, equestrian centres, riding schools and equine professionals who want to digitise and simplify their day to day. From health to invoicing, with each horse's training performance, all on a single platform.

items.question: What does the performance module include?
items.answer: Plan the season towards a competition (volume and intensity phases), log the actual load of every session and get an alert when a horse with a tendon history goes over its intensity limit. Intensity is rated by the rider, so reporting a session is just two data points: how long it lasted and how hard it felt.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use the platform?
items.answer: Not at all. We designed Relincho with a clean, intuitive and easy-to-use interface. Our goal is for anyone to be able to start managing their horses from the very first minute, with no need for complex manuals.

items.question: Is my data and my clients' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. We use the highest cloud security standards. Your data and your clients' data are encrypted and we run automatic backups constantly so you never lose important information.

items.question: How are you handling Veri*Factu compliance?
items.answer: Invoicing works today: series and numbering per year, per-line taxes, automatic boarding fees and SEPA direct debits. Veri*Factu is an AEAT obligation that was postponed to 2027, and we would rather not advertise it as ready until it is: when it arrives we will tell every stud farm. If you need to invoice under Veri*Factu right now, write to us and we will tell you straight before you sign up.

items.question: Can I try Relincho before subscribing?
items.answer: Of course! The Cuaderno plan costs nothing and needs no card: create your account and add up to 5 horses. When the yard grows, move up to Cuadra (breeding, voice and nutrition) or Rendimiento (periodisation and tendon alerts), from €69/mo excl. VAT.

s1.title: 1. Information we collect
s1.intro: At Relincho, we collect information to provide better services to all our users. This includes:
items: Personal information you provide to us (name, email, billing details).
Data about your horses, facilities and clients that you enter into the software.
Platform usage information and cookies (see Cookie Policy).

s2.title: 2. How we use your data
s2.intro: We use the information collected to:
items: Provide, maintain and improve our management software.
Send you important notifications about the service and technical support.
Comply with applicable law (including invoicing regulations).

s3.title: 3. Sharing your data
s3.body: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information with essential service providers (such as payment platforms and cloud hosting) that comply with GDPR security standards, and where required by law.

s4.title: 4. Data security
s4.body: Your data is encrypted and stored on secure servers. We run regular backups to guarantee the integrity and availability of your stud farm or equestrian centre's information.

s6.title: 6. Who processes data on your behalf
s6.body: Relincho acts as the data processor for the personal data you keep in the application (owner records, invoices, your horses' documentation) and only uses it to provide the service. Servers and backups are inside the European Union: the database and storage on Supabase (Frankfurt region) and attachments on Cloudflare R2. Notification emails are sent through Resend and payments are handled by Stripe, which never sees your clients' data. If you are a stud farm and need a signed data processing agreement, write to us and we will send it over.

s5.title: 5. Your rights
s5.body: You have the right to access, rectify or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at relinchoappweb@gmail.com.

s1.title: 1. What are cookies?
s1.body: A cookie is a small text file that a website saves on your computer or mobile device when you visit it. It lets the website remember your actions and preferences (such as sign-in, language and other display preferences) for a period of time.

s2.title: 2. How we use cookies at Relincho
s2.intro: We use cookies for several reasons, mainly to:

items.description: Essential for you to browse the platform and use its features, such as accessing secure areas (signing in to your account).
Help us understand how visitors interact with the site, collecting information anonymously.
Allow the website to remember the choices you make (such as your username).

s3.title: 3. Controlling cookies
s3.body: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being installed. However, if you do this, you may have to manually adjust some preferences every time you visit a site, and some services and features (such as access to your account) may not work.

ia.subtitle: Ask in your own words, see what is coming, and let the system order the work for you.
ia.q1: Which mares are ready to breed this month?
ia.a1: You have 4 mares in heat confirmed by ultrasound and 2 more coming into cycle this week. Lucera and Bordadora have already passed the interval since their last foaling, so they are the clearest candidates.
ia.q2: Which horses are due for vaccination or deworming?
ia.a2: 7 horses have influenza vaccines overdue or expiring within 15 days, and 3 have gone more than 6 months without deworming. I have grouped the appointments by stall so the vet only needs one visit.
ia.q3: How much did boarding cost me last month?
ia.a3: 8,200 € in March: 4,900 € on feed and forage, 1,800 € on vet and farrier, and 1,500 € on staff. That is 12% more than February, almost all of it the rise in forage.
ia.card1Body: Ask about your horses the way you would ask your vet, and get the answer straight away, drawn from your own stud farm's data.
ia.forecastTip: Tip: close your forage contract before June to protect your margin.
ia.card2Body: The AI cross-checks your history to anticipate foalings, forage costs and busy spells before they arrive.
ia.card3Body: Every expense, treatment and entry files itself under the right category, and the system gets sharper every month.
